description: Required applicability decision: includedResourceIdPatterns must contain at least one approved ARM resource-ID pattern; excludedResourceIdPatterns must be supplied and may be empty. Each pattern is exact or uses at most one '*' wildcard, following Policy like semantics. No resource IDs or default scope are assumed. Patterns filter resources already within the assignment scope and never expand that scope.
